projects.title: Heinz Make It Shake
projects.summary: A playful TikTok experience that turns the familiar act of shaking a ketchup bottle into a dance-led game.
projects.credit: Created with the team at Subvrsive, in collaboration with Hogarth.
projects.problem: Translate Heinz’s bottle-shaking ritual into an experience people could play and share on TikTok.
projects.approach: I contributed the gamified visual scripting and Social AR work for Make It Shake. The experience brings together dance cues, a score and a playful end state to make participation feel like part of the campaign.
projects.outcome: A TikTok Branded Effect that turns a familiar product ritual into a participatory dance experience.

image.alt: Heinz Make It Shake social AR gameplay showing the bottle-shaking interaction.

video.alt: Heinz Make It Shake social AR gameplay showing the bottle-shaking interaction.

projects.title: Funko Pop! Yourself
projects.summary: A virtual try-on that lets people create their own Funko Pop! likeness through a series of character choices.
projects.credit: Created with the team at Subvrsive.
projects.problem: Bring the Pop! Yourself product into a social experience where people could see, customize and share their own character.
projects.approach: I worked on visual scripting and Social AR for the character customization experience. Users could choose skin tone, eyes, hair and accessories to create a Pop! that reflected them.
projects.outcome: An interactive character experience tied to the Pop! Yourself product. Subvrsive’s case study reports more than 21.3K user-generated videos.

image.alt: Funko Pop! Yourself character customization and virtual try-on demonstration.

video.alt: Funko Pop! Yourself character customization and virtual try-on demonstration.

projects.title: Coca-Cola Product Concepts
projects.summary: Generative image-making to explore potential products, flavors and collaborations across the Coca-Cola brand family.
projects.credit: Created with the team at Subvrsive for The Coca-Cola Company.
projects.problem: Make emerging product ideas tangible early enough to support creative discussions about potential flavors and collaborations.
projects.approach: I used ComfyUI, FLUX and Stable Diffusion to generate product concept imagery, exploring how proposed ideas could look across the Coca-Cola portfolio. Open-source tooling supported experimentation with different visual directions.
projects.outcome: A collection of speculative product images for creative development and discussion. The visuals explore potential products and collaborations.

image.alt: A collection of AI-generated product concepts for Coca-Cola brands, including Sprite, Fanta, Gold Peak and smartwater.

projects.title: Espolòn at the Latin Grammys
projects.summary: A surreal FOOH campaign that brings Espolòn’s characters into a larger-than-life city scene for the Latin Grammys.
projects.credit: Created with the team at Subvrsive.
projects.problem: Celebrate Hispanic and Latin creators with a campaign idea that could capture attention around the Latin Grammys.
projects.approach: My contribution centered on creative strategy and guidance for the FOOH concept, helping connect Espolòn’s visual identity with the cultural moment.
projects.outcome: The team delivered a FOOH activation built around Espolòn’s distinctive characters and Latin music culture.

image.alt: Espolòn Tequila Latin Grammys film with a skeleton bringing the bottle installation to life.

video.alt: Espolòn Tequila Latin Grammys film with a skeleton bringing the bottle installation to life.

projects.title: InTrust
projects.summary: Estate planning software for law firms, designed to turn structured intake data into high-fidelity legal document packages.
projects.focus: Legal document automation and workflow design
projects.problem: Estate packages are often assembled through repetitive manual drafting, formatting, and document coordination. The challenge was to preserve legal formatting precision while making the workflow faster and easier to repeat.
projects.approach: I built a local-first desktop workflow that guides intake, applies rule-based logic, and generates formatted Word documents while respecting strict legal document conventions.
projects.outcome: The result is a practical automation tool that reduces repetitive drafting effort and creates a foundation for bespoke firm-specific estate planning workflows.

image.alt: InTrust website showing its estate planning workspace and document workflow.

projects.title: CES AI Postcard Generator
projects.summary: A mobile-first interactive postcard concept using prompt-driven personalization to turn event identity into a shareable generated artifact.
projects.focus: Generative interaction design and event engagement
projects.problem: Most event touchpoints are forgettable. The challenge was to create a lightweight, memorable interaction that could turn a quick scan into a personalized creative artifact.
projects.approach: I designed a short prompt flow that captures a visitor’s CES mindset and translates it into a generated postcard composition with a consistent visual frame.
projects.outcome: The concept creates a flexible bridge between physical networking, mobile interaction, and generative media.

image.alt: The CES AI Postcard Generator introduction and its personalized postcard experience.

projects.title: Dell Foundation Digital Gallery
projects.summary: A large-format digital gallery experience blending media, interaction, and storytelling for a foundation-facing display environment.
projects.focus: Large-format web experience and content system
projects.problem: The experience needed to organize rich media and story content for a large display environment without feeling like a conventional website.
projects.approach: I built a fullscreen interactive gallery structure with cinematic tile behavior, modal content, video embeds, and layout logic suited for large-screen viewing.
projects.outcome: The result was an immersive digital gallery prototype that made foundation stories easier to browse, present, and experience.

image.alt: Dell Foundation Digital Museum with its collection of illustrated story tiles.

projects.title: Dogwood Counseling Website
projects.summary: A calm, trust-centered web presence for a Boulder therapist, designed around clarity, warmth, accessibility, and local discoverability.
projects.focus: Client site design, trust-building, and light SEO
projects.problem: The provider needed a web presence that felt calmer, more trustworthy, and more aligned with the emotional tone of therapy work.
projects.approach: I focused on simple information architecture, warm visual language, clear service framing, and accessible contact pathways.
projects.outcome: The site became a more polished and approachable digital front door for prospective clients.

image.alt: Dogwood Counseling website introducing its warm, approachable therapy services.
